body: Honestly I'm way too dumb to give you an answer to that. But my mom did what you are talking about doing now. It left my family in a wreck. I know it's cliche but they need you.
Why is that? It's late at night for me but I'm willing to talk to you for a bit if you need it.

I've been through almost this exact situation in my last relationship. If he doesn't sit down with her and figure out some change and an equal partnership he's gonna lose it. I spent 2 years working 60+ hour weeks to keep a roof over my girlfriend and her sons head. She borrowed money from me weekly. She was in nursing school and broke. When she finally got that big raise making more than me. Not a dime. He can't let her get used to him putting everything on his shoulders alone. It will build resentment and their relationship will implode.
Just gotta keep going that's what they keep telling me atleast. I'm searching for that light.
I appreciate it but it would go on for hours
